raw_market.question: Boise State vs. Fresno State: 1H Moneyline
raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Boise State and Fresno State, scheduled for October 10 at 10:30 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Boise State" if Boise State outscore Fresno State in the first half.

This market will resolve to "Fresno State" if Fresno State outscore Boise State in the first half.

If both teams score the same number of points in the first half, this market will resolve 50-50.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
